name: Voldaren Estate
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Vampire spell.
{5}, {T}: Create a Blood token. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each Vampire you control. (It's an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
blocked_sentences: {T}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Vampire spell.
{5}, {T}: Create a Blood token. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each Vampire you control. (It's an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

needs.what: a mana ability whose 'spend this mana only to...' clause names a creature subtype (Vampire) instead of a card type -- the ability's mana restriction must be able to hold a subtype, and the purpose computed for the spell being paid for must include that spell's subtypes so the restricted source is offered only for a Vampire spell
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The mana restriction an ability may carry is a single lowercased *card type*: the loader rejects any value whose title-case form is not one of the eight known card types, and the purpose a spell presents to the payment solver is built from its types alone, so 'Vampire' has no representation. Dropping the clause would produce unrestricted any-color mana off a land for one life, strictly more permissive than the printed card.

needs.what: a mana cost on an *activated* ability that shrinks by {1} for each permanent matching a filter its controller controls, clamped at {0} -- i.e. a scaling generic component on an ability cost, evaluated when the ability is offered and again when it is paid
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Both existing reductions discount *casting a spell*, not activating an ability: a card's `cost_reduction` field is Ghalta's 'this spell costs {X} less to cast', and the `spell_cost_reduction` static discounts other players' spells via `affects_spells`; both are read only from the cast path (`costs.cost_reduction`, called from the cast/legality code). An activated ability's `cost.mana` is a fixed literal mana string with no place for a count-derived term, and `times` in a cost repeats the whole cost rather than scaling its generic part.

needs.what: a Blood token in the shared token pool -- a colorless artifact token named Blood with the printed activated ability '{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.' so `create_token` can name it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `create_token` requires a `token` id that resolves to an existing card marked `is_token`; `validate_token_references` raises on an unknown id. The pool holds Clue and Treasure artifact tokens plus creature tokens, but no Blood, and a card answer file cannot define one -- the token must be added to the token card pool. Substituting Clue would change both the activation cost and the discard.
